blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: de past continuous vormen met was / were + -ing
beschrijven wat er bezig was op een moment in het verleden
de achtergrond en de gebeurtenis van een verhaal onderscheiden

blocks.label: regelmatig werkwoord
examples: I was reading when you called.
Ik zat te lezen toen je belde.
Jij was de krant aan het lezen.
She was reading in the garden.
Zij zat in de tuin te lezen.
We were reading the same book.
Jullie waren hardop aan het lezen.
Zij waren de menukaart aan het lezen.

head: Bevestigend
Ontkenning
Vraag
rows: I was sleeping.
I wasn't sleeping.
Were you sleeping?
It was raining.
It wasn't raining.
Was it raining?
They were working.
They weren't working.
Were they working?

head: Gebruik
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: Bezig op een moment in het verleden
At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
Om acht uur zat ik te eten.
Achtergrond van een verhaal
The sun was shining and birds were singing.
De zon scheen en de vogels zongen.
Onderbroken door iets
I was cooking when the phone rang.
Ik was aan het koken toen de telefoon ging.
Twee dingen tegelijk
While I was reading, he was watching TV.
Terwijl ik las, keek hij tv.

blocks.title: zat te, stond te, was aan het
blocks.text: Het Nederlands zegt Ik zat te lezen, Hij stond te wachten, We waren aan het eten. In het Engels is dat allemaal de past continuous: I was reading, He was waiting, We were eating.
De lange handeling (achtergrond) staat in de past continuous, de korte gebeurtenis die ertussen komt in de past simple. while hoort meestal bij de lange handeling, when bij de korte.

head: Engels
Nederlands
rows: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Ik liep naar huis toen het begon te regenen.
While she was driving, her phone rang.
Terwijl ze reed, ging haar telefoon.
When I arrived, they were having lunch.
Toen ik aankwam, zaten ze te lunchen.
When I arrived, they had lunch.
Toen ik aankwam, gingen ze lunchen.

blocks.title: Let op het verschil
blocks.text: When I arrived, they were having lunch: ze waren al bezig. When I arrived, they had lunch: ze begonnen pas toen ik er was. De vorm verandert de volgorde van de gebeurtenissen.

blocks.title: Geen -ing bij toestanden
blocks.text: Net als in de tegenwoordige tijd: werkwoorden als know, like, want en need krijgen geen -ing. I knew the answer, niet I was knowing.

rows: I was sleep when you called.
I was sleeping when you called.
Na was komt de -ing-vorm.
They was playing football.
They were playing football.
Bij they: were.
While I watched TV, the lights went out.
While I was watching TV, the lights went out.
De lange handeling: past continuous.
I was walking home when it was starting to rain.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
De korte gebeurtenis: past simple.
I was knowing her.
I knew her.
know krijgt geen -ing.
What did you do at ten o'clock last night? I slept.
What were you doing at ten o'clock last night? I was sleeping.
Bezig op een moment: past continuous.

blocks.text: Vul de past simple of de past continuous in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: I ______ a shower when the doorbell rang.
items.full: I was having a shower when the doorbell rang.

items.q: It ______ when we left the house.
items.full: It was raining when we left the house.

items.q: While they ______ dinner, the lights went out.
items.full: While they were cooking dinner, the lights went out.

items.q: She was driving when she ______ the accident.
items.full: She was driving when she saw the accident.

items.q: What ______ you doing at nine o'clock?
items.full: What were you doing at nine o'clock?

items.q: We ______ sleeping. We were watching a film.
items.full: We weren't sleeping. We were watching a film.

items.q: I ______ my wallet while I was shopping.
items.full: I lost my wallet while I was shopping.

items.q: The children ______ in the garden all afternoon.
items.full: The children were playing in the garden all afternoon.
Was he working when you called?

items.q: Ik zat te lezen toen je belde.
items.a: I was reading when you called.

items.q: Om acht uur zat ik te eten.
items.a: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.

items.q: Wat was je aan het doen?
